text: ① 13:30 台积电公布8月份营业额报告； ② 14:00 德国8月CPI终值； ③ 15:00 国新办就金融领域贯彻落实“十五五”规划、推动金融强国建设有关情况举行新闻发布会； ④ 19:00 土耳其央行公布利率决议； ⑤ 时间待定 石油输出国组织（OPEC，欧佩克）公布月度原油市场报告； ⑥ 20:15 欧洲央行公布利率决议（含主要再融资利率、存款便利利率、边际贷款利率）； ⑦ 20:30 美国8月PPI，9月5日当周首次申请失业救济人数； ⑧ 20:45 欧洲央行行长拉加德举行新闻发布会； ⑨ 22:00 美国8月成屋销售总数年化； ⑩ 22:3
text_en: ① 13:30 TSMC releases its August revenue report; ② 14:00 Final August CPI for Germany; ③ 15:00 The State Council Information Office holds a press conference on implementing the "15th Five-Year Plan" in the financial sector and promoting the building of a financial powerhouse; ④ 19:00 Turkey's central bank announces its interest rate decision; ⑤ Time TBD OPEC releases its monthly crude oil market report; ⑥ 20:15 The European Central Bank announces its interest rate decision (including the main refinancing rate, deposit facility rate, and marginal lending rate); ⑦ 20:30 US August PPI, initial jobless claims for the week of September 5; ⑧ 20:45 ECB President Lagarde holds a press conference; ⑨ 22:00 US August existing home sales annualized; ⑩ 22:3
